payload.summary: The minutes of the 5 March 2026 Licensing committee, and the record of what councillors actually did. Members agreed to change paragraphs 7.1 and 7.4 of the draft so that conditions must be 'appropriate and proportionate' rather than 'necessary and proportionate', which officers said gives the council more room to impose conditions. They asked for wording on making signage legible and on how long premises must keep logbooks and who may inspect them, and one member argued for stronger safeguards for women and girls, including anti-spiking measures and clearer routes to report problems. The committee resolved to recommend the amended draft to Cabinet, to recommend that Cabinet start a 12-week consultation, and to ask Cabinet to consider further steps on the safety of women and girls during it.
